correctness.rationale: For every N>=1 and nonempty F, orthonormal DFT characters yield (2C-I)_{k,l}=0 on same-parity pairs (including diagonal), and (2/N)z_k/(z_k-z_l) on opposite parity. Distinct roots make every maximal square minor of the rectangular Cauchy block nonzero, so rank min(e,o), zero multiplicity |e-o|, and symmetric singular-value pairs follow exactly. Cauchy--Binet and the Cauchy determinant give the positive all-gap formula, including r=0 and balanced/full-frequency boundaries. Replayed 696 finite matrix checks corroborate but are not the proof.

value.rationale: The half-cycle is the natural equal partition for periodic time-frequency concentration, and arbitrary masks capture not only contiguous low-pass bands but gapped and multiband designs. An exact threshold-eigenspace dimension for every mask, and an explicit all-eigenvalue gap product without diagonalization, are mathematically natural invariants relevant to transition-mode counts and stability diagnostics. The theorem is not an arbitrary small finite census, a renamed hypothesis, or a numerical result alone.
